This pertains to the visual and audio arts, to the writings, and to the code itself.

  

If you would like a similar website, then start with:

1.  Writing the outline for the articles you want
2.  Writing the content for those articles
3.  Putting the images together you want for your site
4.  Then drawing or having AI generate a rough draft image of what your site would look like

If you have all of those, then [hit me up](#?/contact). I've taught multiple students vibe coding and can walk you through the same.
